note: Views Argument Token adds a single Views argument_default plugin (id 'token', class TokenArgument) that fills a contextual filter's default value from a Drupal token resolved against the current user / route entity. No admin UI, configure=null, no permissions, no Drush. Its only persistent state is the plugin's options inside a view config entity: display.<d>.display_options.arguments.<arg>.default_argument_type='token' plus default_argument_options {argument, process, and_or, all_option, debug} (schema views.argument_default.token). All medium/hard cases are grounded in real view config: introspection reads the configured token string / options back from a view; execution switches an existing contextual filter to the token plugin and is verified against the live view config.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site I want a Views contextual filter to default its value from a Drupal token like [current-user:uid] or [node:field_tags] instead of the URL. The views_argument_token module is installed. How do I set that up, and what kind of Views plugin does the module provide?
evals.expected_output: views_argument_token registers a Views argument_default (default value) plugin with id 'token'. On the contextual filter, under 'When the filter value is not available', choose 'Provide default value', set Type to 'Token', and enter a token string such as [current-user:uid] or [node:field_tags]. It is resolved at render time against the current user / route entity.

evals.prompt: In the views_argument_token 'Token' contextual-filter default, what does the 'Get fields raw values' option do, and when a field has multiple values how are they combined for the argument?
evals.expected_output: 'Get fields raw values' (option key 'process') replaces field tokens with the field's stored raw value (e.g. an entity-reference field's target ID) instead of the token module's rendered value. Multiple field values are joined by the 'and_or' option: '+' means OR, ',' means AND, so the argument can drive a multi-value contextual filter.

evals.prompt: With views_argument_token, what happens when the configured token resolves to an empty value? Is there an option to still show all results?
evals.expected_output: If the token resolves empty and the 'Send "all" if no value' option (all_option) is enabled, the plugin returns the literal argument 'all' (you must also enable the filter's 'all' exception argument) so the view shows everything; otherwise it returns an empty string. Any unresolved [type:name] token blanks the argument.

evals.prompt: This site has a view with machine name 'vat_user'. Its contextual filter uses the views_argument_token 'token' default-value plugin. Inspect the live view configuration and state the exact token string configured as the default argument.
evals.expected_output: The token string is [current-user:uid]: in views.view.vat_user the 'uid' contextual filter has default_argument_type: token and default_argument_options.argument: '[current-user:uid]'.

evals.prompt: This site has a view 'vat_raw' whose contextual filter uses the views_argument_token 'token' default. Inspect the live configuration: is 'Get fields raw values' enabled, and are multiple values combined with OR or AND?
evals.expected_output: Raw values are enabled (process: 1) and multiple values are combined with AND (and_or: ','). In views.view.vat_raw the token argument options are argument: '[node:field_tags]', process: 1, and_or: ','.

evals.prompt: The view 'vat_task' on this site has a contextual filter on the user id (uid) that currently uses a fixed default value. Using the views_argument_token module, change that contextual filter's default value so it is provided by a token equal to the current user's id, [current-user:uid]. Apply the change to the live view configuration.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.vat_task the 'uid' contextual filter has default_argument_type: token and default_argument_options.argument containing [current-user:uid] (set default_action to 'default' with the token plugin).

evals.prompt: The node view 'vat_rawtask' has a contextual filter on the node id (nid) using a fixed default. Using views_argument_token, make its default value come from the token [node:field_tags] with 'Get fields raw values' turned on (so field values are used as raw IDs). Apply it to the live view configuration.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.vat_rawtask the 'nid' contextual filter has default_argument_type: token with default_argument_options.argument containing [node:field_tags] and process: 1 (Get fields raw values on).
